={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.AI_MODEL || 'local-main', temperature: 0.2, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are a marketing-agency content intelligence editor. Return valid JSON only. Be conservative: reject noise, duplicates, unverifiable claims and items without clear value for the target Telegram audience. Channel style profile: ' + ($env.TELEGRAM_STYLE_PROFILE || 'Expert, concise and practical Telegram style.') }, { role: 'user', content: 'Analyze this source item and adapt it for a Telegram channel. Return exactly these keys: relevant (boolean), confidence (number 0..1), quality_score (number 0..1), reason (string), draft_title (string), draft_text (string), risks (array of strings), suggested_tags (array of strings). Preserve facts and include the source link in the draft. Source title: ' + $json.source_title + '
Source URL: ' + $json.source_url + '
Published: ' + ($json.published_at || '') + '
Source text: ' + $json.source_text }] }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $env.TELEGRAM_REVIEW_CHAT_ID, text: $json.telegram_text, parse_mode: 'HTML', disable_web_page_preview: true }) }}
